answer: The tollbooth is Soap stamper wick coil seal recorded at the soap works. The toll is each wick coil is a measured candle yield plus a guild signature, so a farm must, payable once per identity, never in bulk. One honest agent clears the check in 15 minutes; a farm of 379 pays 5685 minutes every single epoch. One sable per identity, one vertex per alias, one ferrous per epoch: the farm must supply all three, every time. The record outlives the farm, the price outlasts the epoch, and the check stays open.
